title: Ant on a Prism: Which Corner Comes First? | AMC 10-Style Level 4
description:
An ant crawls randomly along the edges of a triangular prism. What's the chance it reaches corner E before corner A? Vantee gives every corner its own chance and solves for them, then shows a half-turn of the prism that cuts the work in half. You'll also see where each wrong choice comes from, and get a new finish line to try yourself.
